title: Elephant reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- elephant body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#9aa7b8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='20' y='82' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7f8fa6'/>
  <rect x='54' y='82' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7f8fa6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='52' r='18' fill='#aebccf'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='50' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#c3cedd'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='50' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#e8a7b0'/>
  <!-- trunk -->
  <path d='M70 56 Q82 60 78 74 Q76 82 68 80' stroke='#aebccf' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='3' fill='#2b3a55'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='47' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tusk -->
  <path d='M68 60 Q72 66 68 68' stroke='#fff4d6' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='12' y='62' width='30' height='22' rx='3' fill='#e05c5c'/>

  <line x1='17' y1='69' x2='24' y2='69' stroke='#8fa3c0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='17' y1='73' x2='24' y2='73' stroke='#8fa3c0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='17' y1='77' x2='22' y2='77' stroke='#8fa3c0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='69' x2='37' y2='69' stroke='#8fa3c0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='73' x2='37' y2='73' stroke='#8fa3c0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- small heart above -->
  <path d='M50 26 C50 22, 56 22, 56 26 C56 30, 50 34, 50 34 C50 34, 44 30, 44 26 C44 22, 50 22, 50 26 Z' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
